newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb kills two Lebanese civilians, wounds two.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills two Lebanese civilians, wounds two.

text.p: A roadside bomb killed two Lebanese civilians and wounded two others in south Lebanon on Tuesday, Lebanese security sources said.

The blast occurred at 11.30 a.m. (0830 gmt) when two men stepped over a bomb planted on the side of a road east of Nabatiyeh, a Shi'ite Moslem market town just outside Israel's south Lebanon border occupation zone, the sources said.
Their truck, parked near a building under construction, was completely destroyed in the blast, a Reuters reporter said.
A car passing nearby was damaged and its driver and his wife, also civilians, were injured, the sources added.
Security forces cordoned off the area.
